spec.description:
Higgins Polyester Sound Blankets (Polyester Acoustic Partition
Rolls) are lightweight, continuous acoustic insulation rolls designed as an
economical solution to reduce unwanted noise transfer through walls, floors, and
ceilings. Manufactured in Queensland from 100% thermally bonded polyester fiber
containing 80% recycled PET packaging materials, they provide high tensile
strength, robustness, and resistance to moisture. Itch-free and requiring no
protective clothing, they deliver safe acoustic sound absorption and thermal
resistance across residential and commercial buildings.
features:
Continuous roll format for fast, joint-free installation in walls, ceilings,
and underfloors

Made from 100% polyester fiber with 80% recycled material
from plastic packaging

Completely itch-free with no formaldehyde binders or
toxic dust
Unaffected by moisture, hydrophobic, and naturally quick-drying
High tensile strength and robustness prevents tearing and sagging

Zero Ozone
Depleting Potential (ODP) and negligible VOC emissions

Meets Australian
Standard AS/NZS 1530.3 for fire safety

Available in widths of 450mm and 610mm
across thicknesses from 50mm to 100mm

Excellent sound absorption for
light-to-medium noise reduction

install:
Measure stud or joist bay
width (450mm or 610mm)

Unroll the polyester sound blanket vertically or
horizontally along framing bays

Friction-fit between timber or steel studs,
or secure to floor joists from below

Cut roll to length using a sharp utility
knife or heavy-duty scissors

Ensure continuous coverage with tightly butted
ends and no gaps

Enclose behind wall, ceiling, or floor linings promptly
after installation
selection_checklist:
Select roll width (450mm
or 610mm) to match framing spacing

Choose thickness (50mm to 100mm) based on
acoustic and cavity depth requirements

Calculate required square meterage to
order roll quantities

Confirm preference for continuous roll installation
over individual batts
limitations:
Indoor use only; not for
direct external weather exposure

Avoid excessive compression beyond cavity
depth
Do not install directly over non-IC rated light fittings
spec.warranty: Backed by Higgins Insulation product warranty

use_cases:
Continuous
acoustic insulation unrolled in internal stud walls for sound attenuation
Underfloor thermal and draft insulation unrolled between floor joists
Acoustic blanket overlay in suspended ceiling spaces above office partitions
retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation
Roll (Polyester Sound Blankets / Partition Rolls) is a continuous bulk acoustic
and thermal insulation roll manufactured from 100% polyester fiber with 80%
recycled PET content. Available in widths of 450mm and 610mm and thicknesses
from 50mm to 100mm, it unrolls smoothly into wall cavities, ceilings, and
underfloor joists to dampen sound transmission and block thermal loss.
Hydrophobic, itch-free, zero-ODP, and compliant with AS/NZS 1530.3 fire safety,
it provides an economical, rapid-install acoustic solution.
